The '''G9 ''Rigger''-class light freighter''' was a type of [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian]] freighter. It was already an aging model by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was slow and unwieldy compared to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. While not a military design, at least one such vessel, the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], saw action in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used it to escape [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] and was intercepted over [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class starfighters]].<ref name="TCW film" /> The G9 Rigger has 3 blaster cannons located on the struts projecting out of the ship. At least one ship of this class was used long after the Clone Wars, during the [[Evacuation of Dac]] over a century later in [[137 ABY]].
